base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key D minor, 102 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: Two-bar melodic hook in D minor: Bar 1 begins on scale degree 5 (A4) with a dotted quarter note, descending on eighth notes through 4 (G4) and 3 (F4) to land on 1 (D4) on beat 4 with a vocal slide. Bar 2 leaps up to flat 7 (C5) on beat 1, resolving down to 5 (A4) on beat 2, holding beats 3-4 with a soft, breathy vocal decay on an open vowel..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Sparse fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar carrying a gentle Dm - Bb motif with light piano ambient accent tones.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: Subtle kick drum on beats 1 and 3, muffled wooden rimshots on 2 and 4, accompanied by a warm melodic bassline moving in quarter notes beneath quiet fingerpicked guitar.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: Building tension with swelling warm pad layers, driving eighth-note bass, crescendo on brushed snare, and rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: Full open acoustic guitar strumming, organic live snare with soft ghost notes, melodic bass locking with the kick, and electric guitar playing the two-bar hook melody.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: Brief musical breather with lead electric guitar repeating the hook motif over warm acoustic strumming and soft kick/bass groove.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Narrative rhythm continues with kick and rim, bass playing melodic scalar runs, subtle shaker entering on eighth notes to push time forward.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Intensity swells with added acoustic strumming, snare crescendo, rolling bass movement, and rising synth texture.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Vibrant rhythm section with wide open acoustic strumming, active bassline, live snare hits, and prominent hook guitar answering vocal phrases.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Arrangement strips back significantly with a pedal point D bass, electric piano introducing harmonic color (Dm9 to Bbmaj7), and muted electric guitar swells.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: Maximum emotional weight with wide stereo acoustics, dynamic live drums, melodic bass counterpoint, and rich vocal harmonies without genre drift.

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: Music resolves gently into fingerpicked acoustic guitar and ambient piano decay, ending on a final sustained low D note.
